title: Research: q=6/7 obstruction for four-label affine targets
body:
## Result

This package gives a scoped negative result for the four-register target `diag(h,h^-1,tx,ty)` over the fixed paid-label subset `{a,b,tx,ty}` of the binary affine group. Each call is `I+([g]+[1])N` for any rank-one idempotent `N` in `M4(F2)`, with arbitrary dirty registers.

The direct predecessor, closed PR #1333, proves exact cost six when every rank-one affine displacement is available as a paid label. This contribution fixes four labels and one target tuple. In the homogeneous affine representation the target displacement rank is six. Exact enumeration excludes q=6 and q=7, so the minimum in this restricted alphabet lies in `[8,10]`; the direct ten-call word is explicit. The exact minimum is unresolved, and no kappa improvement is claimed.

The q=6 certificate recomputes all 480 factors and hashes the complete lowering frontiers. It verifies the direct positive control and rejects a dropped-call and a wrong-label control. The q=7 trajectory program and full captured output are hash-pinned in the certificate. The q=7 absence result uses a necessary representation condition and therefore excludes exact group-algebra words in this declared model.

- q7 program and output hashes: in `research/affine-mixed-four-targets-seed5638/CERTIFICATE.json`

The live overlap review covered 419 open PRs and 375 Discussions with complete pagination and no warnings at 2026-10-14 08:28 UTC. Concurrent Discussion #1738 studies a three-register UT3 central pair with `{x,y}`; the target group, tuple, register count, and search method differ. PR #1711 and #1716 likewise use different affine target tuples/register counts.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/affine-mixed-four-targets-seed5638/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/affine-mixed-four-targets-seed5638/q7_trajectory_search.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/affine-mixed-four-targets-seed5638 --check-only
```

The recorded q7 replay took about 9m34s. The selected conditional kappa remains complex-bound. No physical, helper, recursive, frame, copying, hosting, precision, interface, or restoration saving is admitted. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed.
